summary: WaterBridge Infrastructure LLC filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary WBI Operating LLC completed a private placement of $150 million aggregate principal amount of 6.500% Senior Notes due 2033, upsized from $100 million, as additional notes under an existing indenture. Proceeds will repay revolving credit facility borrowings. The notes are unsecured guaranteed senior obligations, sold under Rule 144A/Regulation S. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
